decisions.reason: The sewer pipe cleaning box builds directly on the firm's fluid-handling and utility customer base, so it is a low-cost extension with no evidence of a shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of its resources.

Public waste bins are distant from the core offer and their returns are uncertain, but industry turnover is growing and the bins serve existing public-sector buyers, which gives the slack to keep the line for now despite a higher drop risk.
The ground sleeve line builds on the firm's fabrication and coating skills and fits its aim to broaden markets, so management has no performance gap prompting it to drop the line.
Cast iron sleeves complement the sleeve line and use known channels, though they may overlap with the steel variant and be consolidated if sales lag the aspiration level.
Steel ground sleeves rely directly on the firm's core steel processing and in-house surface treatment, so they carry low risk and stay in the range.
